## Academy purpose

Bagatur is an academy where children and adults learn Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu technique, discipline and respect in a controlled training environment. Its stated mission is to develop confidence, self-control, calm decision-making under pressure, partner work and personal responsibility. Training is structured for age and experience.

## Coach

The coach presented by the academy is Yordan Petrov (Йордан Петров). The academy states that the main measure of a coach's work is the success of the students. The published coach profile describes a team of children and adults progressing from their first steps on the mats to podium results at national Bulgarian and international Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu competitions.

## Programs

- Children 4–7: play, movement, coordination and first habits for working with a partner.
- Children 8–14: technique, focus, confidence and responsibility on the mats.
- Adults 14+: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for beginners and advanced practitioners.

## Safety and first visit

The academy describes training as safe, controlled and age-appropriate. For a first class, visitors are advised to bring comfortable sports clothing without zippers or hard elements, water and willingness to participate. Parents should call the coach before a young child's first visit.

## Independent press coverage

Flagman.bg published the article "Багатур с 43 медала и 4 отборни титли в Пловдив" on 14 September 2026. Its description reports that the Burgas academy won 43 medals and four first-place team titles at the AGF Plovdiv Championships five months after its creation.

Source: https://www.flagman.bg/article/389904
